feature_contract.goal: Preserve the entire user-positioned F11 desktop shell, its clickable size and input geometry through XR entry, changing recommended-eye density, reset, and return to desktop without snapping native windows to the centre.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: F11 external ImGui shell placement only; preserve F11 atlas quality, controls and focus, gameplay HUD, ESC/GOAL/+TIME, lens, original game input and FFB, SkyGlow, R84/R26_SAFE stereo semantics, and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Desktop ImGui F11 drag and resize creates real window position and hitbox extents.
VR transition uses source-aspect responsive F11 geometry, while preserving last desktop rectangle.
Original ImGui DX9 shell is submitted through the existing external stereo overlay and restored at VR exit without changing native controls.
subcomponents: Save a valid final desktop F11 window rectangle separately from XR compositor-driven centering and resizing.
Force centering and size reflow on real VR layout changes only; restore both desktop position and hitbox size once on leaving VR.
Preserve normal native ImGui user dragging/resizing across desktop resolution changes and ensure no invalid/zero-sized geometry is cached.
On VR exit after a smaller monitor/mirror resize clamp the restored F11 window and hitbox within native content; when no prior desktop F11 snapshot exists, establish native placement once.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: On VR entry and real source or eye density changes re-centre only the VR F11 shell; its existing ImGui controls and pointer hitboxes follow the same ImGui window rectangle.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Desktop input and saved F11 position
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Preserve native desktop F11 manual drag and size across XR entry/exit and ordinary desktop resize without a forced recenter; reject invalid zero-sized snapshots. With a smaller monitor, restore a bounded native window and hitboxes entirely inside the available content; with no previous desktop shell, use original desktop placement.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: x86 R84 game and x64 OpenXR host build plus Domain and source inspector
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Run required DX9Ex Active Windows game and host package, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact and EXE HUD Inspector on the final exact source SHA.

diagnosis.root_cause: The original unified layoutChanged predicate treated desktop mirror resolution changes and the VR->desktop transition as permission to apply ImGuiCond_Always centring, destroying desktop drag placement and discarding its independent interactive window size.
alternatives_rejected: Do not change XR HUD vertex transforms or D3DX game sprite projection: F11 is authored as independent ImGui window geometry.
Do not change native input/FFB or disable user-driven ImGui resize; preserve the original external shell compositor.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: ImGui shell C++ lifecycle now saves desktop rectangle and restores it atomically across XR entry/exit; focused Python positive, negative and destructive source-mutation regression is integrated with canonical F11 verifier. Final preflight source 80b3b5a clamps native ImGui hitbox to content extents and handles first-ever F11 opened in VR; mutation and numeric resolution regressions added.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Original F11 render_shell derived layoutChanged from prior content, density and XR state without restricting it to VR; it used ImGuiCond_Always and a new centered window for both VR and desktop changes.
source_trace: Original user mouse drag/resize writes ImGui F11 window geometry during desktop render_shell.
XR entry re-centres the F11 shell with density-bound size, keeping separate lastDesktopPosition/Size snapshots.
XR exit restores desktop ImGui rectangle before Begin, then captures any new desktop changes after Begin without modifying stereo render owner.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: External VR shell continues using the existing R84 ScreenOverlay2D binocular submission; this change affects ImGui surface and hitbox geometry before per-eye compositing, not the world or gameplay HUD.

next_action: C6 exact-SHA build verified; await real Quest3/VDXR F11 optical, cursor and original desktop/VR live behavior before any HMD acceptance or backend promotion.
